tasks.sql: select business_name as `业务名称`, step_name as `步骤名称`, sum(count) as `访问量`, round(avg(average_deal_time)/1000000,2) as `平均时长(秒)`   from business_step_stat_d where system_name = 'CRM系统' and business_name like '%查询%' and step_name like '%页面%' and create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) and create_time < CURDATE() and average_deal_time < 30000000 group by business_name , step_name  having sum(count) > 50 order by `平均时长(秒)` desc;

tasks.sql: select business_name as "业务名称", step_name as "步骤名称", sum(count) as "访问量", round(avg(average_deal_time)/1000000,2) as `平均时长(秒)` from business_step_stat_d where system_name = 'CRM系统' and business_name like '%查询%' and step_name like "%E" and create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) and create_time < CURDATE() and average_deal_time < 30000000 group by business_name, step_name having sum(count) > 50 order by `平均时长(秒)` desc;

select business_name as "业务名称", step_name as "步骤名称", identify_character as "步骤URL", sum(count) as "访问量", round(sum(average_deal_time * count)/sum(count)/1000000,2) as `步骤响应耗时(秒)`, round(sum(average_client_free_time * count)/sum(count)/1000000,2) as "操作间隔时长(秒)" from business_step_stat_d where system_name = 'CRM系统' and business_name not like '%查询%'  and business_name not in ("专线卫士产品订购","互联网专线开通-NPON3","互联网专线开通-NPON2","互联网专线开通(NPON)","互联网专线开通-PON3","互联网专线开通-PON2","互联网专线开通-PON1","集团通信费统付产品开通","互联网专线开通(PON)","互联网专线开通-NPON1","集团通信费统付产品退订","移动云产品退订","移动云产品开通","小微宽带融合产品开通","集团彩铃退订","集团彩铃开通","集团V网VPN产品开通")  and identify_character not like '/api/chbn/%' and create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) and create_time < CURDATE() and average_deal_time < 30000000 group by business_name, step_name, identify_character having sum(count) > 50 order by `步骤响应耗时(秒)` desc;
